mapper.select: SELECT p.cntrct_ty_cd, p.stlm_mthd_cd FROM prj.prj p WHERE p.prj_id=#{projectId}

SELECT a.asgn_id, a.dev_id, t.work_day_qty, t.rglr_tm_qty, t.ovtm_tm_qty, t.mth_work_day_qty, m.mm_qty AS assignment_mm, (a.asgn_se_cd='FREE' OR price.bill_untprc_amt IS NOT NULL) AS price_available FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=a.prj_id LEFT JOIN bill.dspch_atnd t ON t.prj_id=a.prj_id AND t.dev_id=a.dev_id AND t.work_ym=#{month} AND t.asgn_id=a.asgn_id LEFT JOIN asgn.asgn_mth m ON m.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND m.work_ym=#{month} LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT h.bill_untprc_amt FROM asgn.untprc_hist h WHERE h.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND h.aply_bgn_dt <= GREATEST(#{start},a.bgn_dt) ORDER BY h.aply_bgn_dt DESC LIMIT 1 ) price ON TRUE WHERE a.prj_id=#{projectId} AND p.cntrct_ty_cd='DP' AND p.stlm_mthd_cd IN ('DAY','HOUR') AND a.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED' AND a.bgn_dt <= #{end} AND a.end_dt >= #{start} ORDER BY a.dev_id,a.asgn_id

SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM bill.bill_dtl d JOIN bill.bill b ON b.bill_id=d.bill_id JOIN asgn.asgn a ON a.asgn_id=d.asgn_id WHERE b.prj_id=#{scope.projectId} AND b.bill_stts_cd='CONFIRM' AND d.work_ym=#{scope.month} AND a.dev_id=#{devId} )

INSERT INTO bill.dspch_atnd(work_ym,prj_id,dev_id,asgn_id,work_day_qty, rglr_tm_qty,ovtm_tm_qty,mth_work_day_qty,created_by) VALUES(#{scope.month},#{scope.projectId},#{row.dev_id},#{row.asgn_id},#{row.work_day_qty}, #{row.rglr_tm_qty},#{row.ovtm_tm_qty},#{row.mth_work_day_qty},#{actor}) ON CONFLICT (work_ym,prj_id,dev_id) DO UPDATE SET asgn_id=EXCLUDED.asgn_id, work_day_qty=EXCLUDED.work_day_qty, rglr_tm_qty=EXCLUDED.rglr_tm_qty, ovtm_tm_qty=EXCLUDED.ovtm_tm_qty, mth_work_day_qty=EXCLUDED.mth_work_day_qty, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by=#{actor} RETURNING atnd_id
